g.text: Myeloid RNA and matched promoter accessibility
Separate missions: RR3 RNA/ATAC context above; RR8 sorted-cell donor effects below. Filled points: full-family q < 0.05.
RR8: myeloid-enriched populations; 3- and 8-month age strata. Marker gate excludes both lead genes. Processing day remains confounded with flight.
